verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a static API reference (per-endpoint docs pages and a published openapi.json) and a free test-drive transcription tool on the marketing site. Neither shows an interactive API reference with runnable or try-it examples. The OpenAPI spec is a building block and the demo tool is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
